name: Search Button

properties.name: placement
properties.note: Where it sits: mobile icon, desktop field, or navigation bar

classes.mobile: inline-flex size-touch items-center justify-center text-ink max-[359px]:hidden lg:hidden
classes.desktop: hidden min-h-touch w-full max-w-[13rem] items-center gap-2 rounded-pill border border-line-strong bg-surface px-4 text-body-sm text-ink-muted no-underline lg:flex
classes.bar: col-span-full hidden min-h-touch items-center gap-2 rounded-pill border border-line-strong bg-surface px-4 text-body-sm text-ink-muted no-underline max-[359px]:flex

properties.name: label
properties.note: Accessible name, from a locale string

properties.name: role
properties.note: Marks the desktop field as the search landmark

properties.name: text
properties.note: Visible text, from a locale string; empty shows the icon only

accessibility: A link named by its label; the desktop field carries role search.
summary: The search entry in the header. One component, three placements: an icon on small screens, a labelled field-style button in the header on large screens, and a full-width bar in the navigation panel.
responsive: mobile: icon below 1024 px; desktop: field from 1024 px; bar: inside the navigation panel.
